```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
league_df <- read_csv("data/laser_league_players.csv")
```

## Scatter plot

```{r}
plot_scatter <- ggplot(league_df, aes(matches_played, tag_accuracy_pct, color = role)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Matches vs Tag Accuracy", x = "Matches played", y = "Tag accuracy (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
plot_scatter

ggsave("plot_scatter.png", plot_scatter, width = 6, height = 4)
```

## Bar plot

```{r}
plot_bar <- league_df %>%
  group_by(home_arena) %>%
  summarise(avg_score = mean(season_score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(fct_reorder(home_arena, avg_score), avg_score, fill = home_arena)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_score, 0)), vjust = -0.2) +
  labs(title = "Average Season Score by Arena", x = "Home arena", y = "Avg season score") +
  theme_minimal()
plot_bar

ggsave("plot_bar.png", plot_bar, width = 6, height = 4)
```
